raw:
@q query
  where match
    relation "be eligible for Delay Repay"
    role subject "the user"
    role source "York"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  select ?amount
  where match
    relation "receive compensation under Delay Repay"
    role subject "the user"
    role object "£64 ticket"
    role instrument "delay more than 30 minutes"
    polarity affirmed
  end
